description: React component for a modal dialog allowing users to customize food item variations, select addons, specify special instructions, and add items to a cart in a food delivery web application.

classes.name: VariationModal
classes.description: React functional component for food variation customization modal.

methods.name: VariationModal
methods.description: Main component function handling modal display, state management, variation and addon selection, price calculation, and cart addition.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Increases the quantity of the item.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of the item, minimum 1.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: Calculates total price based on selected variation and addons.

methods.name: onSelectVariation
methods.description: Sets the selected variation and its addons.

methods.name: validateButton
methods.description: Validates if current selections meet addon requirements for enabling 'Add to Cart' button.

methods.name: validateOrderItem
methods.description: Validates the entire order item including addons and variation.

methods.name: onPressAddToCart
methods.description: Handles adding the item to the cart after validation.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds item with selected options and quantity to cart, or updates existing cart item.

methods.name: radioORcheckboxes
methods.description: Renders addon options as radio buttons or checkboxes based on addon configuration.
